§6Combination Oven§f

§aYour earliest source of wood oil and coal tar, and it can run itself.§f

The §bCombination Oven§f is a furnace that uses heat exchange to burn and coke materials while producing liquid byproducts. It needs a §bheat source§f from below, Firebox, Heating Oven, Electric Heater, or Fluid Burner, and it throws fire on top of itself during operation.

The self-sustaining trick: pipe the liquid output into a Fluid Burner below the oven. Wood Oil and Coal Tar Creosote both work as fuel. Use a §bHeating Oven§f instead of a Firebox for faster operation and a bigger heat buffer.

Core recipes: Coal Briquette → Coal Coke + §e150mB§f Coal Tar Creosote. Lignite Briquette → Lignite Coke + §e100mB§f. Coal Powder → Coal Coke + §e100mB§f. It also handles Oil Tar and Crack Oil Tar conversion into Petroleum Coke, plus wood and sawdust briquettes into Charcoal and Wood Oil.

§6Crafting§f (Tier 2 Anvil): §e8×§f Stone Bricks, §e16×§f Oak Wood, §e2×§f Cast Copper Plate, §e16×§f Brick.

§ePS:§f The Combination Oven is available way before the Coker Unit. Use it for early coal processing and petroleum coke production, then transition to the coker once you have the resources.
